objective: Propose the GUI MVP build specification for project Jin: a Tauri 2.11 desktop app that is a pure consumer of jin-core, mirroring the CLI hero flow visually with an approximated Apple HIG / Liquid Glass aesthetic.

context_delta.summary: Decision-ready dual-format spec for the Jin GUI MVP. Architecture fixed by ADR-0003 (Tauri 2.11 + in-process jin-core + VG4 no-direct-SQLite). Decomposes the presentation layer and the command bridge into 9 INVEST stories (GUI-S0..S8) with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN criteria, 8 GUI validation gates, and a 4-milestone sequence. Defines: the recommended 6-view scope (Today/agenda hero + Notes/Tasks/Events browse+detail + Capture/Create + Sync/Settings); HIG sidebar IA with Today-as-home; a concrete web mapping of design.md (11-style type scale to rem, semantic color roles light/dark, Liquid Glass via backdrop-filter with reduced-transparency/increased-contrast/reduced-motion fallbacks, 8pt grid, concentric radii, 44pt targets, Dynamic-Type scaling); the #[tauri::command] surface returning existing DTOs in the existing envelope with exit-code-to-error-state mapping; a frontend stack recommendation (Svelte 5 + Vite + TS, upgrade Node 16 -> 20 LTS); and a headless-aware verification approach (bridge + frontend-logic tests run headless; visual correctness requires owner cargo-tauri-dev sign-off). Open decisions are tagged [USER-DECISION]/[FORGE]/[SPEC]/[GAP]/[ASSUMPTION]; UD4 (framework) and UD5 (Node) should be resolved with the owner before scaffolding. APIVR/builder should start with GUI-S0 (scaffold + command bridge), the fully-headless-verifiable spine, gated on VG-GUI-1/2/4.

expected_response.shape_hint: resolve [USER-DECISION] UD4/UD5 with owner, then build GUI-S0 (scaffold + command bridge) and report; or orchestrator fan-out decision for GUI-S4||S5 + GUI-S7 after GUI-S2

assumptions: jin-core DTO field names (NoteDto/TaskDto/EventDto/AgendaDto/AgendaEventDto with originating_task + prep_notes) match the spec section 4.3 - confirm against jin-core/src/dto/* at GUI-S0.
Tauri 2.11 command/serde interop returns the DTO envelope cleanly across the IPC boundary.
The CLI verb grammar + exit-code taxonomy (thin-slice S3) is the canonical surface the GUI mirrors.
WebKitGTK media-query support for prefers-reduced-transparency/prefers-contrast is inconsistent, so manual in-app a11y toggles are mandatory (GAP G1).
